pairs: In finem,
Unto the end.
filiis Core. Psalmus.
A Psalm to the sons of Korah.
Benedixisti, Domine,
O Lord, you have blessed your land.
terram tuam; avertisti captivitatem Jacob.
You have turned aside the captivity of Jacob.
Remisisti iniquitatem plebis tuæ;
You have released the iniquity of your people.
operuisti omnia peccata eorum.
You have covered all their sins.
Mitigasti omnem iram tuam;
You have mitigated all your wrath.
avertisti ab ira indignationis tuæ.
You have turned aside from the wrath of your indignation.
Converte nos,
Convert us,
Deus salutaris noster,
O God, our Savior,
et averte iram tuam a nobis.
and turn your anger away from us.
Numquid in æternum irasceris nobis?
Will you be angry with us forever?
aut extendes iram tuam a generatione in generationem?
And will you extend your wrath from generation to generation?
Deus,
O God,
tu conversus vivificabis nos,
you will turn back and revive us.
et plebs tua lætabitur in te.
And your people will rejoice in you.
Ostende nobis,
O Lord,
Domine, misericordiam tuam,
reveal to us your mercy,
et salutare tuum da nobis.
and grant to us your salvation.
Audiam quid loquatur in me Dominus Deus,
I will listen to what the Lord God may be saying to me.
quoniam loquetur pacem in plebem suam,
For he will speak peace to his people,
et super sanctos suos,
and to his saints,
et in eos qui convertuntur ad cor.
and to those who are being converted to the heart.
Verumtamen prope timentes eum salutare ipsius,
So then, truly his salvation is near to those who fear him,
ut inhabitet gloria in terra nostra.
so that glory may inhabit our land.
Misericordia et veritas obviaverunt sibi;
Mercy and truth have met each other.
justitia et pax osculatæ sunt.
Justice and peace have kissed.
Veritas de terra orta est,
Truth has risen from the earth,
et justitia de cælo prospexit.
and justice has gazed down from heaven.
Etenim Dominus dabit benignitatem,
For so will the Lord give goodness,
et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
and our earth will give her fruit.
Justitia ante eum ambulabit,
Justice will walk before him,
et ponet in via gressus suos.
and he will set his steps upon the way.
